==Biography==
Damián Rea is from Argentina.

== Trivia ==
* His favorite champions are {{ci|Camille}} and {{ci|Wukong}}. Was a Wukong one-trick-pony in his first years playing the game.
* He likes anime a lot.
* He really loves [[Remilia]]. He also is a fan of [[Smeb]].
* Is a very confident player.
* Considers himself "the best soloqueue player in LAS."
